meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 装上后，选中的 NanoClaw 智能体获得一个真实电话号码和拨号工具，可直接发送短信、拨打 AI 语音电话并接收验证码；未选中的会被阻止，尝试将得到 403。
howto.when: 当用户想让智能体发短信、打电话或运行 `dial …` 命令，且未把 Dial 配成消息频道时；需从 NanoClaw 代码库（宿主）手动运行此技能。

say.text: 让选中的智能体能发短信和打电话
say.note: 技能会为它们配置真实号码和拨号工具。

say.text: 给所有 agent 添加拨号能力
say.note: 运行后会询问你确认授权范围。

say.text: 把拨号工具加到 ag-123 这个 agent 上
say.note: 只让该 agent 获得 Dial 访问权限。

howto.what_en: After installation, chosen NanoClaw agents get a real phone number and dial tool, enabling SMS, AI voice calls, and verification code receiving; unchosen agents are blocked with 403.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel; must be run manually from the NanoClaw repo on the host.

say_en.text: Make the chosen agents able to send SMS and make calls
say_en.note: Configures real numbers and dial tools for them.
Will ask you to confirm the authorization scope.

say_en.text: Add the dial tool to the ag-123 agent
say_en.note: Only that agent gets Dial access.
